entries.0e7c923f0af1a996: This segment covers the instant photo system 'instax' (Cheki), color film, color paper, services and equipment for photo printing, digital cameras and optical devices. This business has continued since photographic film manufacturing began in 1934. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, consolidated net sales were ¥627 billion and operating profit was ¥160 billion, the largest operating profit among the four segments.
entries.17f9836b8346cdec: This business provides office equipment, centered on digital multifunction devices. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales decreased in the Asia-Pacific region, against a backdrop of market weakness in China and Oceania and the discontinuation of low-profitability models, and exports to Europe and North America declined, causing overall sales to fall.
entries.20e724de8188616b: Color Paper, Services and Equipment for Photo Printing
entries.26394d5f5b60432f: This business supplies printing companies with printing plate materials, plate-making materials and production printers. In December 2025 it released the production printer 'Revoria Press PC2120', which uses AI technology to automate and streamline printing operations, and in March 2026 it began offering the cloud service 'Revoria Cloud Production', which uses AI to streamline print production management operations.
entries.2a4da306a0a447f2: Contract Development and Manufacturing of Biopharmaceuticals
entries.2afcc464c50ba574: This business covers medical IT, including endoscopes and the medical image information system (PACS) 'SYNAPSE', and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) equipment and materials such as 'FUJI DRI-CHEM' for blood biochemical testing. In March 2026 it released the portable X-ray imaging system 'CALNEO Xair PLUS' and the bronchoscopes 'EB-840S' and 'EB-840T'.
entries.36691dd03b4416e1: A company that makes medical equipment such as endoscopes, contract manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, semiconductor materials, digital multifunction devices and instant cameras.
entries.36fe270ee6890052: Drug Discovery Support Materials, such as cells, culture media and reagents
entries.3904868a4cc36e4d: This business covers digital cameras. It offers the large-format 'GFX Series' and the 'X Series', which aims to balance image quality and size, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026 it released the 'FUJIFILM GFX100RF', 'X half' and 'FUJIFILM X-E5'. In the same year the company also released the 'FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55', a video production camera and the company's first camera dedicated to video.
entries.44998b3b1c3d30a3: This business handles display materials and resist materials for semiconductors. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales increased as adoption of new display materials advanced. From the same fiscal year, the chemical reagents that had been included in this business have been transferred to the Healthcare segment.
entries.4ac0073fe10625fc: This business contracts with pharmaceutical companies for the development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals. In addition to large-scale manufacturing facilities based in Denmark and small- and medium-scale manufacturing facilities based in Texas, in the fiscal year ended March 2026 it opened a new large-scale manufacturing plant in North Carolina, USA, and began operating eight 20,000-liter animal cell culture tanks. In February 2026 it opened an antibody drug substance manufacturing building and a process development laboratory at its UK base.
entries.4da456448d9ca433: This business consists of the Life Sciences Business, Pharmaceuticals Business, Consumer Healthcare Business and CRO Business. In addition to supplying culture media and reagents to pharmaceutical companies, the Pharmaceuticals Business performs contract manufacturing of clinical trial drugs for a domestically developed COVID-19 vaccine.
entries.50da0cae2ebfda23: In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) Equipment and Materials
entries.59b9ff93d3a7663e: This segment covers digital multifunction devices for offices, business process solutions and services that use them, and graphic communication system equipment and inkjet equipment for printing companies. Centered on FUJIFILM Business Innovation Corp., which was established in 1962 as a joint venture with the UK's Rank Xerox and renamed in 2021, consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,174.8 billion, the largest of the four segments.
entries.7e54d39ad2169e3e: This business supplies materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes. In addition to advanced resists, NTI developers and CMP slurries for copper wiring, it handles liquid polyimide for interlayer insulating films used for chip-to-chip connections in advanced packaging in back-end processes. In February 2026 it completed a ¥5 billion investment in Rapidus Corporation, which aims for mass production of cutting-edge logic semiconductors.
entries.8d40af09a3be9f1e: This segment covers medical system equipment such as endoscopes and X-ray imaging systems, contract development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, drug discovery support materials such as cells, culture media and reagents, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics and supplements. The main companies are FUJIFILM Corporation, Fujifilm Toyama Chemical Co., Ltd., FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical Corporation and FUJIFILM Diosynth Biotechnologies, and consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,098.9 billion.
entries.8d4ceff7e2dd5409: This business centers on the instant photo system 'instax', which lets users enjoy prints immediately after taking a photo. The instax series has surpassed 100 million units in cumulative sales and includes models such as the 'instax mini 12', 'instax mini Evo' and 'instax WIDE 400'. In December 2025 it announced an expansion of production equipment for 'instax Cheki' film.
entries.c4affddb2cd2b574: This business sells and provides implementation support and services for core systems that support DX at companies and local governments. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of DX-related solutions and services and of services for local governments grew, driven by replacement demand following the end of Windows 10 support in Japan. In March 2026 the company acquired ETG Global Information Technology Services Inc. of Turkey.
entries.e8163a2e38043c0c: Liquid Polyimide for Interlayer Insulating Films
entries.f02f921bc4be5c3d: This segment covers semiconductor materials, display materials, industrial materials and fine chemicals. It extends the materials technology developed in photographic film to manufacturing materials for semiconductors and displays, and is handled mainly by FUJIFILM Electronics Materials Co., Ltd. and others. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥456.1 billion.
